messages:
alert-bot: ALERT — anomalous service-account activity detected in us-west-2. 89 failed auths followed by 3 successful token-issue calls. raw ids: svc-deploy-1
marta: seeing it, pulling audit logs now. starting containment steps.
marta: can someone confirm whether that service account is on the new RBAC role? @ashok
ashok: it's bound to role:inference-deployer. I will revoke token and rotate keys for that SA now.
alert-bot: revocation triggered by marta at 11:12 UTC — token invalidated.
julia: if rotation completes, we should check KMS access patterns — look for decrypt ops from unusual hosts.
sam: grabbing audit logs: `aws logs filter --log-group /redwood/api-auth --filter 'svc-deploy-1' | tail -n 50`
sam: sample log:
```
2026-03-20T11:08:45Z INFO auth request grant svc-deploy-1 src=10.2.4.59 userAgent=deployer/2.1
2026-03-20T11:09:02Z WARN failed auth svc-deploy-1 src=93.12.44.1
2026-03-20T11:11:10Z INFO token_issue svc-deploy-1 src=10.2.4.59
```
olivia: good catch. postmortem: need clearer detection tuning to avoid noisy alerts and a playbook for SA compromise.
olivia: propose: create 'sa-compromise' runbook with steps: detect, contain, rotate, forensics, comms, post-incident actions.
marta: +1. quick action items:
- create JIRA RD-9812 runbook draft (owner: olivia) due EOD tomorrow
- audit-log extraction script (owner: sam) due today
- RBAC policy review for deployer roles (owner: ashok) due 48h
- KMS decrypt access audit (owner: julia) due 24h
ashok: will open RD-9813 for RBAC changes, will add proposed least-privilege binding snippets.
julia: will run KMS audit: `gcloud kms keys list --keyring=prod --project=redwood` and grep logs for service-account.
marta: also need comms template — security-notify + product + affected-customer list. olivia can you draft?
olivia: can do. Also scheduling a tabletop next week to walk through SA compromise scenario — invite eng-oncall, eng-platform, devex.
marta: +emoji :calendar: Tentative Wed 14:00 PDT. sam please coordinate with SRE calendar.
sam: will create event and send invites.
olivia: final: add detection tuning ticket RD-9814 to reduce false positives and add enrichment from CTI feed (owner: julia).
alert-bot: Incident closed (containment confirmed). Post-incident tasks created: RD-9812, RD-9813, RD-9814, RD-9815
marta: thanks team — put updates in the incident channel doc and ping for blocker escalations.
